sample.population: the 79368 classes with some |j| = 2 and both other frames present

note: Seeded uniform sample of the (2,1,1) box's new quadruple classes through the omega-3 engine (decision + towers). Elements are (4,2,2)-forms (Im(l^4) enters through the Chebyshev formula); components reach bidegree (16,16), and components of bidegree > 6 are not pulled back, which is why most sampled classes are 'unknown'. The kills use the same mechanisms as in (1,1,1): rank-0 quartics (the (1,1,1) list plus a few new twists), the monomial lemma (now with angle multiples up to 4), and the same tower quotients (30a2, 11a3, 24a1, 80a1, ...) plus a few new ones. A full sweep is ~60 CPU-hours at the sample's cost and was not run.
